methodology.traffic: Open-loop, no retries, 80% critical except background-flood20%, independent60/20/20 orders/catalog/inventory mix.100ms useful-work budget for both priorities includes scheduling+network+queue+handler. SQL delay/failure injection per admitted transaction; everyNth errors are not identical requests across policies. Each phase fully drains before next; controller/token state survives; next phase has no artificial cooldown.
methodology.fairness: All policies share three service processes, PostgreSQL image, pool sizes, deadlines, route handlers and offered schedule. Semaphore and fixed-unreserved isolate a classless concurrency ceiling. Other Gatewise cases reserve1of4 for critical. Rate limits are per service, classless and do not cap active work;100/300/900 rates predeclared, burst4. Proxy cases add a fourth process and hop and are reported as deployment outcomes, not isolated policy-speed comparisons. The direct/rate cases deliberately have no HTTP concurrency cap. Other Gatewise features off.
methodology.selection: Exploratory runs revealed the need for a background-heavy phase; they are excluded. Rates, cases, revised workload and integrity criteria fixed before this subsequent confirmatory matrix; no win gate. Fresh databases each run; rotating case order each repeat. Single local host, no production capacity claim.
